value.rationale: A natural Mordell–Weil torsion classification yields exact existence and exceptional order-two section across an infinite geometric pencil. It refines singular-fiber and rank information with an arithmetic group invariant relevant for isogenies and component behavior, and the jump is explained structurally by cancellation of a degree-three rational map.
